about.heading: What I bring to a team.
pillar.1.title: I learn by building
pillar.1.body: When I pick up a new tool, I want to know why it exists and which problem it solves, so I build something real with it. Right now that means Kubernetes, OpenShift, Terraform and LiteLLM.
pillar.2.title: I use AI, but I own the code
pillar.2.body: I plan the work and pin down the requirements before I write anything. AI makes me faster, but I never ship code I don't understand: I read it, test it and change it when it's wrong.
pillar.3.title: I think about the whole system
pillar.3.body: I've worked on backends, databases, message queues, frontends, CI/CD and cloud deployment. For me a feature is done when it runs reliably in production, not when it works on my machine.
pillar.4.title: I look for the real cause
pillar.4.body: A year in application security taught me to read code the way an attacker would. When something breaks, I look for the root cause instead of a quick patch, and I keep what I learn for the next project.
